integrity: The analytic proof is primary. Reported finite numerical tests are reproducibility checks, not a substitute for an all-parameter theorem.
scientific_limitations: Well-mixed deterministic two-coordinate norm diffusion; one initial intervention only.
Strictly positive linear costs and continuous population fractions; no dynamic optimization or heterogeneous graph targeting.
Published phase portrait and separatrix are premises; new result is the exact cost optimization and allocation transition.
Independent assessment of historical priority remains outstanding.
title: The exact cost frontier for one-shot social-norm seeding
